create_VARParams: create a VARParams instance with custom maxlags, method, and trend settings for a VAR model
fit_VARModel: fit a VARModel to multivariate time series data using OLS estimation with automatic lag selection
predict_VARModel: predict future values with confidence intervals from a fitted VARModel for multiple time series
plot_VARModel: plot VARModel forecast results with historical data and confidence bands for each time series variable
get_parameter_search_space_VARModel: get the default parameter search space for VAR model hyperparameter tuning
